o.text: Morphologically beş + -inci. Cognate with Kazakh бесінші (besinši), Turkish beşinci, Turkmen bäşinji.
From Arabic ثَوَاب (ṯawāb). Compare Bashkir сауап (sawap).
From sevmək, ultimately from *seb- (“to love”). Compare development of /œj/ from /ev/ in dialectal ev (“house”) → öy, neft (“oil”) → nöyüt.
From Persian هیجان (hayajân), from Arabic هَيَجَان (hayajān).
